changeSet.author: minhdat
changeSet.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET status = 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', verified_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'VERIFIED' AND bank_account_id IN ( SELECT p.bank_account_id FROM payouts p JOIN bank_accounts r ON r.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id WHERE r.bank_bin <> p.destination_bank_bin OR r.account_number_last4 <> RIGHT(p.destination_account_masked, 4)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payouts q WHERE q.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND q.destination_bank_bin = bank_accounts.bank_bin AND RIGHT(q.destination_account_masked, 4) = bank_accounts.account_number_last4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_accounts o WHERE o.bank_account_id = q.bank_account_id AND o.payee_id = bank_accounts.payee_id));

changeSet.author: minhdat
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payouts SET bank_account_id = ( SELECT c.bank_account_id FROM bank_accounts c JOIN bank_accounts r ON r.payee_id = c.payee_id WHERE r.bank_account_id = payouts.bank_account_id AND c.bank_bin = payouts.destination_bank_bin AND c.account_number_last4 = RIGHT(payouts.destination_account_masked, 4)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bank_accounts r WHERE r.bank_account_id = payouts.bank_account_id AND (r.bank_bin <> payouts.destination_bank_bin OR r.account_number_last4 <> RIGHT(payouts.destination_account_masked, 4))) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_accounts c JOIN bank_accounts r ON r.payee_id = c.payee_id WHERE r.bank_account_id = payouts.bank_account_id AND c.bank_bin = payouts.destination_bank_bin AND c.account_number_last4 = RIGHT(payouts.destination_account_masked, 4)) = 1;
